
TAG-STATS
Display statistics about tag usage across feature files

USAGE
  fspec tag-stats

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Show tag usage statistics
  $ fspec tag-stats
  Tag Usage Statistics:

@critical: 45 features, 123 scenarios
@high: 12 features, 34 scenarios
@cli: 30 features
@parser: 15 features

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec list-tags
  fspec validate-tags
  fspec register-tag

NOTES
  • Shows how many features and scenarios use each tag
  • Helps identify unused or underused tags
  • Only counts tags that are actually used in .feature files
